But `refreshOAuthTokens` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true. A `Response` does not have a `.data` property, so `token` becomes `undefined` and `token.access_token` will throw at runtime in sync-endpoint mode.
